scope: Discover first-entry presentation only; not whole-page or whole-app acceptance

source.authority: User explicitly requested same-geometry three-card placeholders, parallel first-photo decode, gentle rear-card fan and one edge sweep, immediate touch takeover and no replay on warm returns.
source.conventions: Both convention files read in full and unchanged by this task. The requested deck-internal motion does not replace cRise or introduce staggered list/page fly-ins.

implementation.skeleton: Discover opts into eager content in MainTabFrame. Its three real card nodes remain mounted throughout the original 600ms skeleton; actual name/tag geometry is masked in place instead of substituting a differently sized skeleton layout.
implementation.media: Each real card acquires its existing media-cache lease, loads and decodes during the skeleton, then reveals the real pixels. A six-image bounded in-memory decoded pool avoids placeholder/fade replay on warm Tab remounts. No storage or business entities are added.
implementation.motion: Rear-card inner faces fan subtly for 560ms; one theme-gradient edge sweep lasts 800ms; photo opacity fades for 240ms. They run after readiness without extending the content timer or locking any gesture. Root transforms stay owned by existing drag/rebound/exit behavior.
implementation.takeover: The first accepted pointerdown consumes and cancels decoration, but retains the existing pointer and gesture state. Touch before a slow photo becomes ready prevents a later decorative replay.
implementation.failure: Slow resources keep the light photo-area placeholder while the 600ms content timer ends normally. Actual errors offer Retry photo; retry re-enters media loading and does not replay the failed entrance.
implementation.lifecycle: Identity includes auth scope, user ID and photo URL. Source changes, stale async results, hide/unmount, timer cancellation and reduced-motion changes are guarded. Reduce Motion disables fan/sweep and leaves the photo fade only.

wkwebview.initial_infrastructure_failure: The first XCTest host was killed before establishing its test connection; test-without-building retry of the same binary passed. No functional failure or source workaround was involved.
wkwebview.limits: Native tests exercise actual WKWebView rendering, safe areas, supplied image decode and scoped pointer listeners using diagnostic DOM pointer events, not physical finger input. Slow/failure and reduced-motion injections are additionally covered in Chrome.

verification.warnings: No convention or browser warnings; existing Xcode AppIntents metadata-skipped warning and simulator WebKit/Accessibility diagnostics remain in native logs.
